hot_shader.name: presentPS / PSMain
hot_shader.body: two texture fetches, then Rec.709 to sRGB, or Rec.709 to Rec.2020 followed by the ST.2084 curve

ceiling_probe.what: the whole colour-transform chain removed; the two texture fetches kept
ceiling_probe.result: FAILS the gate, and in the direction that settles it: deleting every colour conversion in the shader leaves the present pass within half a percent. The pass is 69 % of the frame and is not limited by its arithmetic - it is a full-screen pass over two texture fetches

oracle_note.observed: the very first process of the session produced a different image from the five that followed: 12 pixels of 921 600, all inside one horizontal band at y 655-664, max delta 22. Runs 2 through 9 are byte-identical to each other, and all four ablate_present processes are byte-identical to each other
oracle_note.rule: the preregistered oracle rule requires baseline processes to be identical to each other, so this workload's oracle is recorded as having FAILED that test on its first process
oracle_note.consequence: none for this verdict, which was decided by the ceiling gate before any transformation. Had a transformation been attempted here, it would have carried this caveat
oracle_note.pattern: the same shape as U-A's 11.8 % timing outlier on its first process - both are first-process-of-a-build effects whose cause is not established, and both are recorded rather than explained away
